```js
// F7: compare priorities by meaning, not by exact string.
function normPriority(v) {
  if (typeof v !== 'string') return null;
  const m = v.trim().toUpperCase().match(/^P([1-4])$/);
  return m ? `P${m[1]}` : null;
}
function normCategory(v) {
  return typeof v === 'string' ? v.trim().toLowerCase() : null;
}
const CATEGORIES = ['billing', 'bug', 'how-to', 'account', 'outage'];

export function gradePriority(out, ref) {
  const o = normPriority(out);
  return {
    priority_correct: o !== null && o === normPriority(ref),
    // Strict metric: the right priority written exactly as 'P1' to 'P4'.
    priority_correct_strict: typeof out === 'string' && /^P[1-4]$/.test(out) && out === ref,
  };
}
export function gradeCategory(out, ref) {
  const o = normCategory(out);
  return { category_correct: CATEGORIES.includes(o) && o === normCategory(ref) };
}
```
